Built with the DMD fork (compile-server prelude), as gs-builds is. The accept steps are the independent check that every port passes exactly (petclinic-rest 109/109). Re-pinned with its siblings at bae71bd6a19b: petclinic-rest's edit_source fixed (controller/v1); at befd9649 the smoke runs gave Java, Go and Flint 18/18, 1/1 and 109/109. Re-pinned with its siblings at 6ab588f8340c for m7-flint-cli's 6ab588f8 (the platform description record no longer goes stale after a debug or static priming build, so cold trials skip dub describe; flint's cold phase 72-84 to 18-19 ms locally) and 943466fa (8 link threads by default). The 21:08Z certified run's secondary is invalid (its scratch lacked --no-platform-cache) and its static edit build was unmeasured; the measure block is corrected at the coordinator's request, and this part re-runs after the runtime entries. Re-pinned at e77bc654025b: m7-flint-cli's per-module incremental compilation (e77bc654; petclinic edit compile ~0.5 s to ~0.15 s locally) with flint-aot's describer memoization (30cebc6a, 04cad3aa, c7da6040).
